picks.title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
picks.rationale: New product launch: Shopify Canvas lets merchants build and restyle storefronts conversationally with live preview, which changes how commerce UI gets designed.
picks.excerpt: Shopify’s new Canvas site builder lets merchants create and customize their online stores by chatting with its AI agent Sidekick, while watching the changes happen in real time.

picks.title: We asked five AI tools to build accessible websites. All 15 sites failed.
picks.rationale: Hard data (AudioEye study) that every AI-built site failed WCAG Level A, a direct, actionable warning for anyone shipping AI-generated UI.
picks.excerpt: An AudioEye study had OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and Lovable tools build 15 sites; all failed WCAG Level A, averaging 55 issues per page, while 81% of teams believe AI code is compliant.

picks.title: Workflow Lab: From Design System to Campaign in Figma Weave
picks.rationale: Hands-on Weave recipe using the Gen Effect and Figma nodes to turn design-system raw materials into campaign collateral; a reproducible workflow, distinct from the 9/17 community-publishing story.
picks.excerpt: This workflow shows you how to turn raw materials into brand campaign collateral using the Gen Effect and Figma nodes in Figma Weave.

picks.title: Headless AI will make every product a platform. Here's what to consider when designing for this.
picks.rationale: Fresh design-practice insight: when agents consume products headlessly, the design surface moves to the contract underneath, with concrete considerations for designers.
picks.excerpt: Chat will always be just an interface; agents are not, and the design work has moved to the contract underneath your product.
